start: A member with no workouts of their own in MettleUp and a Hevy export .csv saved on the phone

steps.action: Settings > 'Bring in from Hevy or Strong'
user_sees: 'Bring in your workouts from another app'
'Which app are you moving from?' with rows 'Hevy' ('Your workout file, or a link to a shared routine.') and 'Strong'
'Your file is read on your phone. Nothing is uploaded.'
must_not: The file sent to a server

user_sees: Screen 'Import from Hevy' with the 3 steps, starting 'Open Hevy and go to Settings → Export & Backup Data.'
'After your workouts come in, we build your routines from the workouts you repeat most.'
Button 'Choose Hevy file'
must_not: Strong's steps on the Hevy screen

user_sees: 'Reading…' on the button, then the preview: 'Workouts', 'Sets', 'Exercises', 'Date range'
New exercise names each with MettleUp's closest exercise to say 'same as'
'Replace' selected with 'Import into an empty history.'
must_not: Replace selected when the member has own workouts
A frozen screen on a 3-year file

user_sees: 'Importing 40 / 120 workouts' with a percent bar
'Building your history and finding your records. If you leave, it finishes on its own.'
must_not: Two imports from a double tap
Half the workouts saved after a failure

user_sees: The routines offer: 'Hevy’s file has your workouts but not your saved routines. We built 3 routines from the workouts you repeat most. Tick the ones you want.'
must_not: Routines added without ticking
'1 routines' in the singular case

start: A member moving from Strong, with a Strong export that has no units in it

steps.action: Settings > 'Bring in from Hevy or Strong' > 'Strong'
user_sees: Steps starting 'Open Strong and go to Settings → Export Strong Data.'
'Strong doesn’t export saved routines. After your workouts come in, we build your routines from the workouts you repeat most.'
must_not: Hevy's steps shown

user_sees: Choices 'Kilograms and km' and 'Pounds and miles' with an example set from the file
Main button 'Choose kg or lb first' until one is picked
must_not: Weights imported as kg when Strong showed lb

user_sees: Weights saved in kg from the lb in the file
must_not: 100 lb saved as 100 kg

start: A member who shares a Hevy file to MettleUp from the Files app, or a Hevy routine link

user_sees: The import screen opens and reads the file at once
must_not: The file read twice

steps.action: On the Hevy screen tap 'Paste a Hevy link' instead
user_sees: 'Have a Hevy routine link?' then the routines exactly as saved
must_not: Workouts made from a routine link

start: A member who picks a photo or an unrelated .csv

steps.action: Tap 'Choose Hevy file', pick the wrong file
user_sees: 'This file isn’t a Hevy or Strong export. In Hevy: Settings → Export & Backup Data. In Strong: Settings → Export Strong Data.'
must_not: A crash or a raw error text
The picked file left in the phone's cache

steps.action: Pick a Hevy export with no workouts
user_sees: 'No workouts were found in that file.'
must_not: An empty import that says it worked

start: A member with 80 workouts logged in MettleUp who imports the same Hevy file a second time

user_sees: 'Merge' selected: 'Keep your current workouts and add these. A workout already here is skipped, also one you logged in MettleUp too (same day, started within 30 minutes), so it’s safe to re-run.'
'Already in MettleUp' count; if all are here: 'Nothing in this file is new to MettleUp, so nothing will be added.'
must_not: Replace chosen for the member
Duplicate workouts after the second run

user_sees: 'Delete 80 workouts first?' naming how many are only in MettleUp, button 'Replace'
must_not: Workouts deleted without that question

start: A member who just replaced 80 workouts with an import

user_sees: '80 workouts replaced' with 'Undo'
must_not: No way back after Replace

user_sees: Every workout back as it was before the import; the imported ones gone
must_not: Imported and old workouts mixed
The undone workouts still sent to Health Connect

user_sees: 'The import failed. Nothing was changed. Please try again.'
must_not: Part of the file imported
The member's own workouts deleted

start: A member importing a Hevy file while signed in to a gym

user_sees: 'Your file is read on your phone. Nothing is uploaded.'
Imported workouts appear in the member's own history
must_not: The export file uploaded to MettleUp or a third party
The file kept in the phone's cache after reading
